reference_sql:
SELECT 'Voltmarkt' AS source, list_price_eur AS price_eur
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id = 2
UNION ALL
SELECT competitor, price_eur
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE product_id = 2
alternatives: WITH price_points AS (SELECT product_id, 'Voltmarkt' AS source, list_price_eur AS price_eur FROM price_history UNION ALL SELECT product_id, competitor, price_eur FROM competitor_prices) SELECT source, price_eur FROM price_points WHERE product_id = 2
SELECT competitor AS source, price_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id = 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'Voltmarkt', list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE product_id = 2

other_way.sql: WITH price_points AS (SELECT product_id, 'Voltmarkt' AS source, list_price_eur AS price_eur FROM price_history UNION ALL SELECT product_id, competitor, price_eur FROM competitor_prices) SELECT source, price_eur FROM price_points WHERE product_id = 2
other_way.tradeoff: Stacking every product in a CTE and filtering once needs only one WHERE, but it stacks rows the question never uses.
